-- Buscar Lucas em allowed_clients (por nome e email)
SELECT 'allowed_clients' AS tabela, id, email, name, is_active, created_at
FROM allowed_clients
WHERE name LIKE '%Lucas%' OR email LIKE '%limir%' OR email LIKE '%lucas%'
ORDER BY id;
